_readme: Prices and request settings for option B. USD per million tokens. A model can make live or batch calls only when approved is true; edit approved yourself after checking the numbers against the provider's pricing page on the run date. A null price means unknown: dry-run then reports tokens only, and live calls are refused.

claude-sonnet-5-5.source: claude-api skill model table (cached 2026-11-03) and its prompt-caching notes: $2 / $10 per MTok, cache reads $0.10 (0.05x), cache writes 1.25x input for the 5-minute TTL and 2x for the 1-hour TTL, Message Batches 50% of standard. Not checked against the live pricing page.

request_settings.temperature: not set: non-default values are rejected on this model

notes: thinking: {type: disabled} returns a 400 on Claude Sonnet 5.5; {type: between_tools} is its way to turn thinking off, accepted only at effort high or below, with no other field.
No fallbacks parameter: the model string recorded with every answer must be the model that answered.
Structured output through output_config.format (json_schema); prefill is not allowed.
